summary: Hallandale Beach should keep its standalone municipal control row. The city still operates Hallandale Beach Police Department, official city materials show a current chief and command staff, a 24-hour police department, separate Fire Rescue - BSO listings, and the city published all twelve 2024 HDPD Monthly Crime Incidents PDFs. FDLE still recognizes FL0060400 and published Hallandale Beach Police Department as a municipal offense row through 2020, then retained a blank transition row in 2021 before omitting Hallandale from the public FIBRS workbook. A packet-local 2024 annual extract built from the full monthly PDF roster now supplies a usable offense-level local-publication repair, so the prior all-fill condition is confirmed as a live-city-police state-publication and repo continuity failure on FL0060400, not a Broward sheriff contract-city case and not an invalid municipal target.
